label: AI Insight UI — Schemas
info:
Pure UIBUILDER Trino schema browser per FAP §10. Two actions:
  schemas.list                    — list catalogs/schemas/tables in INFORMATION_SCHEMA
  schemas.describe (params: catalog, schema, table) — DESCRIBE a single table
Uses the Trino OIDC token-grant flow with the same env vars the AI Insight backend uses (AI_INSIGHT_TRINO__*). Returns msg._result for fn_build_response.
